tools.name: draft_list
tools.description: Turn one sentence about a plan or errand (for example "Friday dinner for 8", "packing for a weekend with kids", "ערב שישי ל-8") into a ready-to-use list written by Justy. No account needed. Returns the items (grouped by aisle for shopping lists) and a justlistapp.com link where the user can keep the

tools.name: write_list_with_justy
tools.description: Justy writes a list from one sentence (for example "shopping for Friday dinner for 8") and saves it to the user's Just List account. Shopping lists come sorted by aisle. Returns the saved list's id and link. Counts toward the account's daily Justy lists; when those are used up it says so, and create

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new list in the user's Just List account with a title and, optionally, items exactly as given (no Justy). Returns the list's id and link.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Add items to an existing list the user is on (their own or one shared with them). Use list_my_lists first to find the list id, e.g. for "add milk and eggs to my weekly list". People sharing the list see the items appear.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Read one of the user's lists: its items with checked/unchecked state and the first names of the people it is shared with.

tools.name: list_my_lists
tools.description: The user's recent lists (most recently changed first, archived ones left out) with their ids, plus their recent Events. Use it to find the list id for add_items, get_list or share_link.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an Event (a dinner, a party, a class trip…) with the things people should bring, each with a quantity. Returns a guest link: guests open it in any browser, no app or account, and claim items with their first name. For "a birthday lunch with 12 guests", suggest items sized for 12.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: For one of the user's Events: who claimed what and what is still unclaimed. Pass the guest link, or nothing for the most recent Event. Answers "what's still unclaimed on my event?".

tools.name: share_link
tools.description: Make an invite link for one of the user's own lists. Anyone who opens it can join the list and edit it with them. Only for lists the user created.

tools.name: view_event
tools.description: Read-only. Open a Just List Event guest link (…/p/<code>) and see what the host asked people to bring and what is still unclaimed, exactly as the guest page shows it. No account needed. Use it before claim_item, or when a user pastes a guest link and asks "what is still needed?".

tools.name: claim_item
tools.description: For a guest: claim something to bring on a Just List Event, using the guest link the host sent and the guest's first name — exactly what the guest page allows. Pass the item's text as shown on the Event. If the item is not found, the reply lists what is still open.
